license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to engage or to continue in this state in the business of contracting, or to act as a contractor as defined in this Chapter, unless he holds an active license as a contractor in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

name.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

type.quote: The major classifications are: (1) Building construction. (2) Highway, street, and bridge construction. (3) Heavy construction. (4) Municipal and public works construction. (5) Electrical. (6) Mechanical. (7) Plumbing. (8) Hazardous materials. (9) Residential construction. (10) Mold remediation. (11) Home improvement.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant, each principal, and each designated qualifying party shall complete an application and pass a background investigation. An applicant shall provide all information or documentation requested by the board, including but not limited to documentation relative to identification, criminal history, and financial history. The board may deny approval of the applicant, any of its principals, or any qualifying party for cause.

required.quote: An applicant for licensure shall designate a qualifying party for each classification and for the Louisiana business and law requirement. The qualifying party shall meet all application requirements and shall satisfy any examination and credential requirement.

experience_source.quote: An applicant for licensure shall designate a qualifying party for each classification and for the Louisiana business and law requirement. The qualifying party shall meet all application requirements and shall satisfy any examination and credential requirement.

exams.name: Trade examination (Electrical classification)
exams.notes: The board may waive the trade portion of the examination for applicants holding a comparable license in another state. The business law requirement shall not be waived.
exams.quote: Waive the trade portion of the examination requirement for any applicant holding a license in a comparable classification in another state as determined by the board, upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the examination for the classification and is in good standing. The business law requirement shall not be waived.

exams.name: Louisiana Business and Law examination
exams.notes: Required for all classifications; cannot be waived even for out-of-state applicants.
exams.quote: An applicant for licensure shall designate a qualifying party for each classification and for the Louisiana business and law requirement.

interval_years.quote: Licensees shall elect upon renewal one-, two-, or three-year license renewal terms, and licenses may be issued by the board on a multiple-year basis, not to exceed a three-year renewal term for any license.

available.quote: Waive the trade portion of the examination requirement for any applicant holding a license in a comparable classification in another state as determined by the board, upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the examination for the classification and is in good standing. The business law requirement shall not be waived. Applicants shall comply with all other licensing requirements of this state; however, for good cause, the board may waive any other licensing requirement.

requirements.value: Trade exam waived for applicants holding a comparable license in another state with written certification of passing the exam and good standing; business law exam still required; all other licensing requirements apply unless waived for good cause.
requirements.quote: Waive the trade portion of the examination requirement for any applicant holding a license in a comparable classification in another state as determined by the board, upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the examination for the classification and is in good standing. disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking or performing construction work without possessing a required license or without the proper classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking, attempting to, or submitting a price or bid; offering to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down; furnishing labor or furnishing labor together with material or equipment; or installing material or equipment for any building, highway, road, railroad, sewer grading, excavation, pipeline, public utility structure, project development, housing, or housing development, improvement, or any other construction undertaking without possessing a license for which a license is required or without possessing a license with the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or circulating a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing, transmitting, distributing, or otherwise publicly circulating a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification in any medium, including but not limited to digital platforms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor which has caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor which has caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bidding on or performing a job for which the licensee does not hold the classification for the majority of work performed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Bidding on, quoting, estimating, or performing a job for which a license is required, the licensee shall hold the classification for the majority of work performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license or providing false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license; misrepresentation of fact by an applicant or licensee in providing information, statements, or documents to the staff or board; deception by omission; and providing false testimony to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of the Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of this Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work requiring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work or activity for the performance of which a license is required by this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a license to be used by any person other than the licensee, or fraudulent use of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license to be used for any purpose by any person other than the person to whom the license is issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide written notification to the board of changes to application information or pending legal actions within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide written notification to the board of any change to the information provided in the original application and any amendments thereto within thirty calendar days.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting a person to circumvent the provisions of the Chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting a person to circumvent the provisions of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide written insurance and license information to the contracting party upon request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a contractor performing residential construction, home improvement, or mold remediation in accordance with this Chapter to provide, in writing to the party with whom he has contracted to perform services, his name, license number, classification, and current insurance certificates evidencing the amount of liability insurance maintained and proof of workers' compensation coverage when requested by the contracting party for whom the work is to be performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project, or deviating from plans without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project engaged in or undertaken by any licensee or deviating from or disregarding plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner and the design professional.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain a required permit or beginning work prior to permit issuance, or misrepresenting the value or scope of work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain a permit to perform work or beginning work prior to the issuance of a permit in the jurisdiction as required or misrepresenting the value or scope of work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to bid, contract, or perform work in the name as it appears on the current license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to bid, contract, or perform work in the name as it appears on the current license or registration and the official records of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain and provide requested records to the board within five business days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain and provide to the board requested records, documents, and other information as required within five business days of receipt of request.
